methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected directly from each provider's own pricing page on 2026-06-13; every USD figure appears on the fetched page (web-analytics tools quote the starting price at their lowest pageview/datapoint tier). Usage-based plans note the published per-event rate in the plan notes, and quote-only / contact-sales tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd = null. Minutes/calls/overage fields are null because they do not apply to this software vertical; corroborating sources are added where a base price was cross-checked.
